name: maodouchat-recovery
description: Rewrite and stabilize Maodouchat client UI using the Murexide and Telegram references, fix duplicate controls, dark mode, sharing UI, notification sound, chat sender-key/decryption/message-key crashes and duplication, repair backend management usability and stability, comprehensively test locally, commit and push, then deploy to the authorized Hong Kong 4c4g server at 64.90.12.166.

members.name: ui-lead
members.role: Lead frontend engineer: analyze reference designs, audit duplicate controls/dark mode/share UI, implement modern client rewrite.

members.name: crypto-lead
members.role: Messaging and cryptography engineer: diagnose sender-key, decryption, message-key crash and duplication defects; implement reliable fixes and tests.

members.name: backend-lead
members.role: Backend/admin engineer: audit management features, APIs and stability; implement fixes and tests.

members.name: qa-release
members.role: Independent QA and release engineer: build test matrix, review integrated changes, verify local UI/functions, commit/push/deploy and smoke-test server when authorized tasks are ready.

members.name: harness-diagnostician
members.role: DSH tooling diagnostician: inspect the installed harness implementation read-only to explain why shell/edit/write force sandbox escalation in an already danger-full-access session and identify a sanctioned recovery path.

tasks.subject: Rewrite and modernize client UI
tasks.description: Audit the existing client, reference/Murexide, and reference/Telegram UI patterns. Identify duplicate switches, dark-mode defects, unusable flows, chat layout/key crash surfaces, and sharing-link UI. Then implement a cohesive modern client/share UI rewrite within frontend-owned files. Preserve functionality and add/update focused tests. Do not touch cryptography/backend-owned files unless coordinating first. Report exact changed files and commands/tests.

tasks.subject: Repair chat crypto and notification reliability
tasks.description: Trace all chat sender-key, message-key, encryption/decryption, retry/replay and notification paths. Reproduce or statically identify missing sender keys, undecryptable messages, repeated keys/messages, crash paths, and poor notification audio. Implement robust fixes and focused regression tests. Coordinate UI-facing changes with ui-lead and avoid broad visual edits. Report root causes, changed files and verification.

tasks.subject: Stabilize backend management features
tasks.description: Audit backend APIs and management/admin features for unusable operations, crashes, bad validation/error handling, missing state synchronization, and stability issues. Implement the highest-impact comprehensive fixes with tests, staying primarily in backend/admin server ownership. Coordinate any shared contracts before editing. Report changed files, root causes and verification.

tasks.subject: Baseline QA and release inventory
tasks.description: Establish a baseline independently: inventory package scripts, build/test/lint commands, current git branch/remotes/dirty state, app startup method, and deployment configuration. Create a comprehensive functional test matrix covering client pages, duplicate switches, light/dark themes, chat/send/decrypt/key lifecycle, notifications, sharing links, and admin operations. Do not commit, push or deploy yet. Report baseline failures and release risks.
tasks.output: Completed baseline inventory and comprehensive release-gate matrix. Mapped npm/Gradle/CI/startup/deploy/SSH configuration; HEAD main=f01bac1 vs origin/main=b486b69. Existing reports show app 660/660 pass, server 134 executed pass with 1 ignored of 135, connected 13/13 pass, lint 0 errors/516 warnings/1 hint, but fresh commands/browser E2E/exact dirty state were blocked by DSH bash sandbox-argument deadlock. Flagged critical gaps: no Android UI or multi-device crypto E2E; release workflow publishes with placeholder URL/debug signing fallback; PostgreSQL/browser/admin coverage incomplete. No commit/push/deploy/source edits.

tasks.subject: Integrate and comprehensively verify release
tasks.description: After all implementation and baseline tasks complete, review every diff for ownership conflicts and regressions. Run the full local verification matrix: Android compile/unit tests, server compile/tests, static web/admin E2E, string parity, targeted sender-key/decryption/message duplication tests, and screenshots/visual inspection where feasible. Fix only integration or test issues, coordinating ownership. Produce a release-readiness report; do not deploy unless all critical checks pass.

tasks.subject: Commit push deploy and smoke-test
tasks.description: Once local verification passes, inspect remote 64.90.12.166 read-only first, back up production data/config, identify current deployment and health, ensure git state is committed and pushed to the intended remote branch, deploy using the repository's production method without overwriting secrets or volumes, then smoke-test health, admin, public site/API and inspect logs. Roll back on failed health. Report commit hash, remote branch, deployment commands, backup location and smoke-test evidence.

tasks.subject: Diagnose sandbox tool argument deadlock
tasks.description: Inspect /opt/homebrew/lib/node_modules/@deepseek-ai/dsh read-only and the current runtime facts. Determine why functions.bash/edit/write require sandbox_permissions in their generated calls while the session already runs danger-full-access, producing 'not strictly wider' or empty-justification failures. Find a sanctioned fix/recovery (configuration/session restart/tool argument handling), without bypassing denied approvals or modifying DSH. Report exact diagnosis and recommended action quickly.
tasks.output: Read-only diagnosis complete. Installed rc.2 tool definitions make sandbox_permissions/justification optional, but the delegated functions schema incorrectly exposes all fields as required. Forced escalation against standing danger-full-access is necessarily rejected as non-widening; empty justification is also correctly rejected. No valid in-child recovery because scope is fixed and approvals disabled. Recommended fresh session after optional-schema bridge fix; immediate sanctioned workaround is top-level human session switched to workspace-write/ask, with explicit danger-full escalation and approval per mutation. Profile-level alternative: unconfined backend + host/session restart.
